tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: tshig bdun sgrub thabs zab mo las: bde chen rgyal mo'i mchod gsol bzhugs: :

bde chen lhan cig skyes mar 'dud: ye shes dbyings nas las kyi tshul: sgyu 'phrul skur ston rnal 'byor ma: gsang chen zab mo'i mdzod gnyer ba'i: dhā ki kun gyi dbang phyug ma: mchod gsol gtor ma 'bul ba ni: ban+dha rin chen snod bzang du: dkar zlum pad+mas brgyan pa dang: dbang drag bshos bu mtheb kyus bskor: bza' bca' sna tshogs ci 'byor spungs: sman phud rak+ta'i skyems la sogs: dgyes skyed mchod pa'i dam rdzas bsham: bdag nyid gu ru'i ting 'dzin gsal: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis nyes skyon sbyangs: mtshan 'dzin rtog bral ngang nyid las: rlung me thod pa'i sgyed pu'i steng: rab yangs pad+ma bhañdza'i nang: sha lnga bdud rtsi 'bru lnga bcas: rlung mes bskol bas bdud rtsir zhu: rlangs par zla dkyil 'bru gsum mtshan: 'od 'phros ye shes bdud rtsi bkug: dam tshig bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor 'dres: zag med 'dod yon sprin 'phro gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes brjod mchod gtor byin gyis brlab: mdun gyi dbus su pad zla'i steng: hrīḥlas bde chen rgyal mo ni: dkar gsal mdzes 'dzum gser 'od 'bar: phyag gnyis rdo rje tshe bum bsnams: dar dkar na bza' g.yang lugs gsol: rin chen me tog rgyan gyis spras: zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs: de yi g.yas su pad nyi la: baṃ las bde chen dbang phyug ma: dmar mo sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams: lcags kyu g.yas la zhags pa g.yon: dar dmar pad phreng rus pas brgyan: 'od dmar dbus su brkyang bskum gar: g.yon du pad nyi ro gdan la: bh+yo las bde chen khros ma ni: mthing nag khro rngam ral pa g.yeng: gri gug phyar zhing thod khrag rngub: khro mo'i chas rdzogs me dbus 'gying: kun gyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan: 'khor du mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro dang: sha za dman mo brtan ma sogs: grangs med nyi zer rdul ltar 'tshubs: bdag nyid thugs las 'od 'phros pas: ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med thim:

gu gul tshil chen dud pa btang: thod rnga rkang gling bshugs glu bcas: hrī: mkha' dbyings bde chen klong yangs nas: ye shes sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs pa: gsang chen bka' yi gnyer 'dzin cing: mchog thun dngos grub kun gyi bdag: zhi chags khros pa'i rnam 'gyur sogs: cir yang ston pa'i 'phrul mo che: mkha' 'gro kun gyi dbang phyug ma: bde chen rgyal mo zhes su grags: dus drug sgrub pa po la gzigs: ma bas byams shing sring bas gdung: grogs ltar brtse zhing bran ltar gus: mkha' 'gro mang po'i dbus na 'gying: shugs 'gro mang po bran du bkol: ma mo bye ba las la 'gyed: bdag gis gdung bas spyan 'dren na: sngon gyi thugs dam ma g.yel bar: skad cig nyid la gshegs su gsol: ma ma dhā ki ka ra sid+dhi ma hā su kha su rī ba shang ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ pheṃ pheṃ dzaḥdza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo na mā mi: hrī: mkha' 'gro bde chen dbang rgyal mo: khros ma 'khor dang bcas pa la: phyi mchod lha rdzas nyer spyod dang: nang mchod 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga: bdud rtsi sman phud rak+ta'i skyems: bza' bca' sna tshogs ba liṃ ta: byang sems dkar dmar bde ba'i rgyun: mchod sgrub skong ba'i dam tshig rdzas: dgyes rgu'i longs spyod bsam mi khyab: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral pa yi: dur khrod drag po'i mchod sprin sogs: dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul te 'bul: zag med bde bas rab mnyes nas: 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi: ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod: ma hā sarba pū dza ho: khyad par gtor 'bul phrin las bcol: hrīḥm hā su kha dzñā na dhā ki nī i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: baṃ ma hā su kha ba shaṃ de bī i daṃ= bh+yo ma hā su kha kro dhī kā li i daṃ= dharma pā la ni dhi pa ti ma ma dhā ki nī sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ= hrī: lhan skyes ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: thabs kyi cha lugs sna tshogs kyis:

mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda chos ston: las dang skal par ldan pa la: dkar 'dzin bde chen mkha' klong nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ster: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin grogs mdzad cing: dam nyams srog gi dwangs ma ni: thabs kyi sgo nas len par byed: zhi chags 'bar ba'i nyams ldan ma: sprul pa mngags gzhug bcas pa rnams: dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bdag cag dang: mi 'bral ma bu bzhin du 'grogs: skye 'gro'i mos pa'i snang ba ni: dkar po'i dge la bsgyur ba dang: mchog dang thun mong rnam gnyis kyi: dngos grub bdag la bstsal du gsol: rjes 'jug skal ldan bu slob rnams: log pa'i lam du ma gtang bar: dag pa mkha' spyod zhing khams su: skad cig nyid la lam sna drongs: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: sarba pā paṃ dz+wa ra ro ga mṛt+yu a pa kā ra shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: āḥyuḥpuṇ+ye shrī maṅga la swasti puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru bh+rūm̐: e waṃ su kha dha ra bh+rūm̐ hring a hring dzaḥdza: sha truṃ bigh+nān bi nā ya ka mā ra ya hūm̐ rbad phaṭa: hrī: kun tu bzang mo dbyings kyi yum: gsang sngags bstan pa srung ba'i phyir: sna tshogs sprul pa'i cho 'phrul gyis: rnam bzhi'i phrin las mdzad la bstod: sku sprul dkar mo zhi zhing mdzes: rdo rjes sgrub pa'i bar chad sel: bum bzang rnal 'byor tshe bsod spel: dbyings phyug bde chen rgyal mor bstod: gsung sprul dmar mo sgeg cing chags: lcags kyus khams gsum dbang du sdud: zhags pas brtan g.yo 'ching bar byed: bde chen dbang gi rgyal mor bstod: thugs sprul mthing nag khro gtum rngams: gri gug dgra bgegs srog rtsa gcod: thod khrag dam sri'i snying khrag 'thung: bde chen khros ma nag mor bstod: 'khor gyi ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: las la myur zhing bstan pa srung: dam ldan rnal 'byor skyong mdzad cing: ci bcol phrin las sgrub la bstod:

hrīḥhūm̐ bh+yo: ye shes dhā ki dbyings nas bzhengs: ma tshogs mkha' 'gro las la bskul: sngon gyi tha tshig ji bzhin du: phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab: las dang rkyen las gyur pa yi: nad rims dal yams dus min 'chi: byad phur rbod gtong gdon dang bgegs: rmis ltas mtshan ma ngan pa sogs: byang chub sgrub pa'i mi mthun phyogs: chos kyi dbyings su zhi bar mdzod: tshe dang bsod nams snyan grags dpal: mnga' thang stobs 'byor brgyud 'dzin dang: ye shes yon tan rig rtsal rnams: 'dzad med dbyar gyi mtsho ltar spel: brtan g.yo srid zhi'i dwangs ma'i bcud: legs pa'i dpal yon dbang du sdus: khams gsum lha 'dre mi rnams kyi: snying rtsa rang dbang med par sgul: zas gos nor gyi char pa phob: bstan dang sgrub la 'tshe ba yi: dgra bgegs dam sri rgyab rten bcas: drag shul stobs kyis tshar chod la: kha phung rjes med rdul du rlog: rnam shes chos nyid klong du stims: mdor na las dang dngos grub kun: thogs pa med par bsgrub par mdzod: ces bskul phud gtor mkha' la 'thor: phrin las sgrub pa'i grogs mdzad nas: gtso 'khor rang bzhin gnas gshegs bsam: lhan skyes dhā ki'i dbang phyug 'di: bsten na byin che mchod na 'go: dam tshig can la lhag par brtse: las rnams gang 'dod thogs med 'grub: bar dor mkha' spyod gnas su 'dren: de phyir mos shing gdung ba yis: mchod bstod phrin las bskul ba la: dus dang rgyun du brtson pa gces: sa ma ya:
